title: DANGEROUS PSALM 91 MORNING PRAYERS THAT WORKS
text: Somebody's under attack right now. I don't mean metaphorically, I mean there is a coordinated deliberate demonic assignment running against your life at this very moment. And you have been sensing it, you have been feeling it in the atmosphere of your home. You have been feeling it in the unexplained anxiety that grips you in the early hours. You have been feeling it in the patterns, the same thing happening in different packaging over and over again. You are not imagining it. It is real. But here is what the enemy does not want you to know. The weapon exists, the shield exists, the fortress was built before the attack was launched, and it is called Psalm 91. Before we go one step further, I need you to do something. Right now, not at the end of this word. Pick up your phone and share this message. Not because the algorithm needs it, because the spirit of God has positioned you as a watchman. Ezekiel 33:2-6. The watchman who sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, the blood of those who perish is on his hands. You are holding a trumpet right now. There is someone in your network who is in the crosshairs of the enemy tonight. They do not have language for what they are feeling. They do not know there is a sum, a fortress, a dwelling place, a secret place that was written for exactly this moment. Blow the trumpet. Share this word. It is an act of obedience. It is an act of love. Someone's life will change because you did not keep this to yourself. Now, settle into your seat. Open your spirit, not just your ears. Because what I am about to show you in Psalm 91 is not information you process with your mind. It is revelation you receive with your spirit. And there is a difference. Information changes what you know. Revelation changes what you are. Psalm 91 verses 1 and 2. And I want you to hear this, really hear this for the first time. He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God in him will I trust. Now go to verses 9 through 11. Because thou has made the Lord which is my refuge, even the most high thy habitation, there shall no evil befall thee. Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. And then verse 14 and 15, and this is where God himself speaks. Because he had set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him. I will set him on high because he had known my name. He shall call upon me and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him. Three sections, three dimensions of the same truth. And inside these verses is a secret that most preachers skip over. A secret that when you discover it will completely change how you pray this Psalm and how this Psalm prays over you. Listen carefully. Most believers quote Psalm 91 as a shield. They quote verse 7, a thousand shall fall at thy side as a blanket protection verse. They quote verse 11, he shall give his angels charge over thee as a comfort scripture. And these things are true, but they are the fruit, not the root. They are the result, not the requirement. And if you only know the fruit without understanding the root, you will quote this Psalm your whole life and never fully access what it contains. There are dimensions to Psalm 91 that the average believer has never accessed. And the secret is in the very first word of the very first verse. The secret is dwelling. He that dwelleth in the secret place not he that visits, not he that passes through, not he that drops in when he is desperate. Dwelleth. The Hebrew word is yashab. It means to sit down, to remain, to stay, to inhabit, to settle. It is the word used for someone who has moved into a house, not someone checking into a hotel. It is the word for someone who has unpacked their bags and put their name on the mailbox. The protection of Psalm 91 is not available to the occasional visitor. It is the covenant inheritance of the permanent resident. This is what nobody tells you. This is the secret that changes everything. The reason many believers recite this Psalm and still live in fear, the reason many believers quote verse 7 and still tremble at what they see in the news is because they are trying to claim the protection of a resident while living as a tourist. Hear me, this is not theology. This is encounter. God is not withholding protection from you. He's inviting you into a dwelling, into a relationship of permanent abiding, and the protection is the automatic consequence of that dwelling. It is not something you get, it is somewhere you live. John chapter 15 verse 4, Jesus said, "Abide in me and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself except it abide in the vine, no more can ye except ye abide in me." Abide. Same word, same concept, same secret. The branch does not produce fruit by trying harder. The branch produces fruit by staying connected. The protection of Psalm 91 does not come by quoting it louder. It comes by staying in the presence. The spirit of God is saying something right now. He is saying you have been trying to access the benefits of the secret place from the outside. You have been standing at the gate reciting the address hoping the coverage extends to where you are standing, but the address does not protect you. The dwelling protects you. Move in. Now, what is the secret place? Because if dwelling is the key, you need to know what you are dwelling I N. The secret place of the most high. The Hebrew is sethar elyon. Sethar means a covering, a hiding place, a place of concealment. Elyon means the most high, the supreme one, the one above all powers. This secret place is not a geographical location. It is not a prayer closet, though a prayer closet is a good idea. It is not a church building, though the gathering of believers carries presence. The secret place is a relational position. It is the place you occupy when you are truly, intimately, permanently in fellowship with the most high. Psalm 27 verse 5. For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion. In the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me. He shall set me up upon a rock. He shall hide me. This is the language of divine concealment. The enemy cannot attack what he cannot find. The enemy cannot destroy what God has hidden. The secret place is God's hiding place for his children. When you dwell there, you become invisible to the enemy's targeting system. Colossians chapter 3 verse 3. For ye are dead and your life is hid with Christ in God. Hid with Christ in God. Two layers of divine protection. Hidden in Christ and Christ is in God. To get to you the enemy has to go through God, then through Christ, then through the blood of the covenant. The enemy does not have clearance for that journey. He never will. I decree and declare over every life under the sound of this voice, you are hidden. Every satanic targeting system assigned against your life, I blind it by the blood of Jesus. Every monitoring spirit that has been tracking your movement, I cut its assignment. Every demonic arrow that has been aimed at your destiny cannot find you. You are hidden in the secret place. You are covered by the shadow of the almighty. Now verse two, I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress. My God, in him will I trust. I will say, this is the second secret nobody tells you about Psalm 91. The protection is not just accessed by dwelling, it is activated by saying. Your mouth is a key. The declaration of your lips is a spiritual lock and unlock mechanism. This is why the enemy works so hard to make you silent. This is why he sends discouragement because a discouraged believer goes quiet. This is why he sends grief and shame and confusion because a confused believer stops making bold declarations and a silent believer is an unprotected believer. Not because God has withdrawn, but because the activation key has been set down. Romans chapter 10 verse 10, for with the heart man believeth unto righteousness and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation. With the mouth, not just in the heart. The heart believes, but the mouth establishes. The heart receives, but the mouth enforces. This is why David said, I will say, not I will think it, not I will believe it privately. I will say, he is my refuge sayer, he is my fortress sayer, my God sayer. In him will I trust sayer, every morning before the news, before the phone notifications, before the email inbox, you open your mouth and you say it. You establish the spiritual atmosphere of your day with the declaration of who God is to you. And when that declaration is made, the angels move into position. When that declaration is made, the covering descends. When that declaration is made, the secret place opens his door. Thus sayeth the spirit of God. The mouth that has been silenced by the enemy is about to be reopened. The declaration that was shot down by shame is about to be restored. The believer who stopped speaking because nothing seemed to be working is about to receive fresh faith for their voice. Speak again. Your words are not empty. They are loaded with covenant authority. Now verse 3 through 6. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers and under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyeth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday. Four categories of attack, four quadrants of enemy operation. And God covers all four. The terror by night, the spiritual attacks, the dreams, the visitations, the oppression that comes when the world is asleep. The arrow by day, the visible, strategic, calculated attacks, the betrayal, the slander, the sudden crisis in business or career. The pestilence that works in darkness, the invisible silent killer, the sickness that creeps, the disease that grows undetected. The destruction that waste at noonday, the public open devastation, the attack that comes in full view in your prime at your peak. The enemy attacks in every season at every angle in every dimension. But the resident of the secret place is covered in every season at every angle in every dimension. He shall cover thee with his feathers. This is the language of the mother eagle. When danger approaches the eagle does not send the eaglets to fend for themselves. She spreads her wings and she covers them. She absorbs the blow. She takes the strike before it reaches the young. This is your God. He does not watch the attack come and cheer you on from a distance. He covers you. The blow meant for you hits the wing of the almighty instead. And the wing of the almighty does not break. I need you to stay with me because we're getting to the verse, the verse that contains the secret that changes everything. Verse seven, "A thousand shall fall at thy side and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee." A thousand at your side, 10,000 at your right hand and none of it reaches you. This is not just poetry. This is a battlefield image. Thousands falling in the same environment where you are standing. The same economy but your finances hold. The same epidemic but your body stands. The same wave of attacks that takes out everyone around you and you are still standing. Verse eight says, "Only with thine eyes shall thou behold and see the reward of the wicked." You will be a spectator of devastation, not a victim of it. You will watch the collapse from a position of divine covering. And people will ask, "Why are you still standing?" And your answer will be the testimony that brings them to the secret place. Every altar erected against your standing, I pull it down by fire. Every arrow that has been aimed at your life, it falls short. Every pestilence assigned to your body, it finds no landing place. You are covered, you are hidden, you are dwelling in the secret place. Someone under the sound of my voice right now, you have been in a season where everything around you seems to be collapsing. People you know losing jobs, marriages breaking, health failing, and you have been wondering, am I next? The Lord says you are not next. You are covered. The assignment against your life has been neutralized by the blood of the covenant. Stand still, watch the salvation of the Lord. Exodus 14:13. Now, verse 9 through 12. Because thou has made the Lord which is my refuge, even the most high thy habitation, there shall no evil befall thee. Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. Because there is that word again. The protection is conditional not on your perfection, but on your positioning. Because thou has made the Lord thy habitation. Because you have chosen dwelling over visiting. Because you have made the secret place your permanent address. Because of that choice, he shall give his angels charge over thee. Hebrews 1:14. Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? The angels are real. The assignment is real. The protection is active right now over your life. There are angels with your name on the assignment sheet. There are angels who know your route to work. There are angels who know the route your children travel. There are angels who have been dispatched to stand at the gates of your home. 2 Kings chapter 6 verse 17. Elisha prayed and the eyes of his servant were opened and the servant saw the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. The army of heaven was already there. The servant just could not see it. The army of heaven is already there around your life. You cannot see it, but it is there. Deployed, armed, activated, waiting for the word. They shall bear thee up in their hands. The images of angels literally catching you. When you stumble, they catch you before you fall. When the road gives way, they hold the ground beneath your feet. When the enemy tries to make you dash your foot against a stone, they move the stone. This is not metaphor. There are people in this room, people who connected to this word, who have survived things that should have killed them. Car accidents that made no sense. Situations where something moved and they do not know what it was. Moments where they felt a pull, step back, take a different route, don't go in there today. That was not instinct. That was angels bearing you up. I decree fresh angelic deployment over every life connected to this word. Angels of protection be activated. Angels of divine guidance be released. Angels who excel in strength, Psalm 103 to 20, go before this person into this week. Clear the road. Guard the household. Protect the children. Now we pray. This is where the teaching stops and the activation begins. This is where Psalm 91 goes from being a passage you have read to a fortress you inhabit. Rise if you are able. Lift your hands and enter this prayer as a resident, not a visitor. Father, we come before you through the blood of Jesus. Hebrews 10:19, we enter the holiest by the blood of Jesus. Not by our eloquence, not by our record, by the blood. And that blood is speaking right now better things than the blood of Abel. Hebrews 12:24. It is speaking access. It is speaking covenant. It is speaking these ones are mine. Father, we make our declaration. We will say of the Lord, "He's our refuge. He's our fortress. He's our God. In him and in him alone we trust." We choose the secret place right now. We're not visiting today, we're moving in. We are making the most high our habitation. We are unpacking our fears, our anxieties, our uncertainties, and we are leaving them at the door of the secret place. And we are picking up the covering. We are picking up the shadow. We are picking up the wings. Father, deliver us from the snare of the fowler. Every trap that has been set for our feet, expose it. Every deceptive opportunity that looks like a blessing, but is a snare, reveal it. Every relationship that is designed to derail our destiny, expose it before we walk into it. Every business deal that carries a hidden hook, expose it. Every covenant that the enemy is trying to get us to enter unaware, expose it. I decree every snare set for your feet, it is broken. By the power of the blood of Jesus, broken, broken, broken. The enemy will not catch you in his trap. Your eyes are open. Your spirit is discerning. Your feet are guided. Father, cover us with your feathers. Cover our minds. The terror by night, the nightmares, the visitations, the oppression that comes in sleep, I bind every spirit of night terror right now. Every demonic visitation in the dream realm, I shut it down by the blood of Jesus. Every dark dream that has been communicating defeat into your spirit, I cancel it. I speak peaceful sleep. Psalms 4:2-8, I will both lay me down in peace and sleep. For thou, Lord, only makeest me dwell in safety. There is a person under this voice who has not slept through the night in weeks. They wake at 2:00 a.m., at 3:00 a.m. with a heaviness they cannot explain. The Lord says the assignment that is stealing your sleep is being terminated tonight. I decree peaceful rest returns to you from this night forward. Lie down without fear, close your eyes without dread. The shadow of the Almighty is your blanket. Cover us from the arrow that flies by day. Every strategic attack against our lives, the sudden crisis, the unexpected bad news, the calculated betrayal, every Judas that has been positioned close to us, Lord, expose them before the kiss. Every Delilah assigned to discover the source of our strength and cut it, expose them. Proverbs 2:11, discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee. I decree supernatural discernment, discernment of spirits, discernment of motives, the right people staying close, the wrong people being separated by the providence of God. Cover us from the pestilence that walks in darkness. Every sickness that has been assigned to our bodies, I rebuke it by name. Every silent disease that has been growing undetected, I command it to be exposed and expelled. By the blood of Jesus, no plague shall come nigh our dwelling. I speak to everybody under this voice right now. Every cell that has been receiving wrong instructions, I command instructions to be corrected by the spirit of God. Every organ that has been under siege, I speak divine reinforcement. Every sickness that has overstayed its welcome in a temple of the Holy Ghost evicted. 1 Corinthians 6:19, your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost, it is holy ground and sickness does not have legal residency in holy ground. I speak to cancer. Every cancerous cell in every body connected to this prayer, you are illegal. You were not planted by the Father John 15:22 and every plant the Father did not plant shall be rooted up. I root you up now by the power of the Holy Ghost. Die in the name of Jesus. I speak to blood disorders. The blood of Jesus speaks healing into every bloodstream that is disordered. Every blood condition, sickle cell, leukemia, hypertension, every name the doctors have given it. I decree the blood of Jesus which is the most powerful substance in the universe is flowing through your veins right now. And where the blood of Jesus flows, disease cannot remain. There is a woman I see her she has been dealing with a gynecological condition for 4 years. She has had procedures, she has taken medication, nothing has resolved it. She's tired of doctor's offices. She's tired of the same conversation with no new answers. The Lord says to that woman, I am your Jehovah Rapha. I am the Lord who heals. And what medicine has not been able to finish I finish tonight. I decree complete healing, total restoration, no residue, no recurrence. Father, because we have made you our habitation, Let no evil befall us. Let no plague come nigh our dwelling. I speak to households. Every household connected to this prayer, I cover it with the blood of Jesus. As the blood was applied to the doorposts in Exodus 12, I apply the blood now to the doors, to the windows, to the walls, to the foundation. The death angel cannot cross a blood-covered threshold. No evil shall enter. No plague shall visit. The household is covered. I speak to children. Every child connected to the lives of those engaged with this word, I decree angelic protection over them. To school, from school, at play, in sleep, every predator human or spiritual assigned against your children, I bind it. Every influence trying to corrupt the minds and hearts of your children, I cut it off. Isaiah 54:13, "All thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children." I decree great peace over your children, spiritual covering over your children. There is a parent under this voice, they have a prodigal. A child who has gone far, farther than they ever imagined. The parent has been interceding and has begun to wonder if the intercession is reaching heaven. The Lord says, "Every prayer you have prayed for that child is in the bowls of heaven." Revelation 5:8, "The bowls are full and they are about to tip." I decree supernatural intervention in the life of that prodigal. A divine encounter that no human could have engineered. They are coming home by fire, by mercy, by the sovereign love of God. Now, I speak to the enemies. Every principality and power that has set itself against the people under this covering. Ephesians 6:12, we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world. We are not wrestling against people, we are wrestling against the dark powers behind them, and those powers have already been defeated. Colossians 2:15, he spoiled principalities and powers. He made a show of them openly triumphing over them. The victory is not coming, the victory is done. We are not fighting for victory, we are fighting from victory. We are enforcing a verdict that was issued at Calvary. Every witchcraft assignment canceled. Every evil covenant annulled by the blood. Every generational curse broken at the cross. Every demonic altar carrying the name of anyone connected to this prayer consumed by fire. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost fall on every dark altar. Let the fire of God incinerate every sacrifice made against our lives. Let the fire of God scatter every witchcraft gathering assembled against our destinies. By fire, by fire, by fire, I decree every covenant your ancestors entered that is still haunting this generation, it is annulled tonight. Galatians 3:13, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law. The legal basis for the curse has been destroyed. The enemy is operating illegally when he enforces a curse on a blood covered life, and we are serving him notice right now, your case is dismissed. There is a man, I see the name Emmanuel. He has been dealing with a pattern. Every time he gets close to his breakthrough, something destroys it. It has happened four times in different areas, business, career, relationship, ministry, and he has started to believe it is his fault. But, the Lord says it is not your fault. It is a pattern with a spiritual root, and we're pulling that root up tonight. Every ancestral altar operating against Immanuel's advancement, I pull it down by fire. Every generational pattern of near breakthrough, then collapse, it ends tonight. I decree, Immanuel, your next attempt is your arrival, not your near miss, your arrival. Now, Father, verse 14, God speaking, not David, God. Because he had set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him. The secret, the final secret, the entire protection of Psalm 91, the dwelling, the covering, the angels, the thousand falling, it all rests on one thing. Not your performance, not your perfect attendance, because he had set his love upon me. The protection of Psalm 91 is a love response. God is saying because this person has set their love on me, because they have made me their first choice, their dwelling place, their habitation, I will personally guarantee their protection. I will personally answer when they call. I will personally be with them in trouble. I will personally deliver them. I will personally honor them. This is the secret nobody tells you. Psalm 91 is not primarily about protection. Psalm 91 is primarily about love. The protection is the fruit of the love relationship. The covering is the consequence of the intimacy. The dwelling in the secret place is the reward of a heart that has chosen God above all else. Matthew 6:33, seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all these things shall be added onto you. Seek first, then all these things shall be added. The protection is in the priority. The covering is in the seeking. The secret place is found by those who make finding it their first business every morning. Father, we set our love upon you right now. Not because we are performing for heaven, not because we are trying to earn the covering, but because you loved us first. One John 4:19 and love responds to love. We set our love upon you. You are our first choice. You are our habitation. You are our secret place. And because we have set our love upon you, we receive the promise. You will deliver you as in every trial, you will deliver. In every attack, you will deliver. In every valley, you will deliver. And not just deliver honor. He says, "I will deliver him and honor him." The enemy meant shame, God decrees honor. The enemy meant failure, God decrees honor. The enemy meant the end of your story, God decrees honor. I speak to the person who has been through public humiliation, a failure that people watched, a collapse that was witnessed, a moment of shame that feels like it has defined you. The Lord says, "I am going to honor you in the same public arena where you were humiliated." The same people who watched the collapse will watch the coronation. I decree public vindication, public honor, public restoration. By the God who delivered and honored, verse 15, those who called upon his name, with long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation, verse 16. Long life. The final promise of Psalm 91, not a life cut short by the enemy's agenda. Not a premature departure. A long life satisfied, full, complete, fruitful. A life that fulfills every chapter God wrote before the foundation of the world. Psalm 139:16, all my days were written in your book before any of them came to be. I decree long life over everyone connected to this prayer. No premature death, no untimely departure. You will live to see your grandchildren. You will live to see the fulfillment of the promises. You will not die in the desert. You will enter the promise and you will walk the land. I speak divine preservation over every form of transport. Every car journey this week, every flight, every commute, the angels have been given charge. They will bear you up. No accidents, no crashes, no near misses that become disasters. The protection of the secret place travels with you wherever you go. I speak to finances one final time. Every financial attack that has been operating under the category of the destruction that wastes at noonday, the sudden collapse, the unexpected expense, the door that slammed without warning, I bind the spirit of financial destruction. I release the spirit of divine provision. Malachi 3:11, the devourer is rebuked for your sake. What has been consuming your harvest is being driven away. What has been reducing your increase is being removed. I decree financial stability, financial growth, financial overflow. There is a woman, her name begins with R. She has been holding a business that should have failed months ago. She has been sustaining it on faith and the little that remains. She has told no one how close to the edge it actually is. The Lord says, I have seen every day you chose faith over logic. I have seen every morning you open those doors when you had no natural reason to believe they should stay open. I decree divine turn around for that business. The right clients are coming, the right contracts are being signed in heaven right now. The business that almost closed is about to expand. By the God of Psalm 91, Father, we thank you. We thank you because you are not a God who makes promises and forgets them. Numbers 23:19, God is not a man that he should lie. What you said in Psalm 91 stands. It stood when David wrote it. It stood when Israel read it. It stands right now. And every person who has engaged with this prayer has just made it their covenant address. We thank you for the secret place. We thank you for the shadow. We thank you for the feathers and the wings. We thank you for the angels. We thank you for the promise I will be with them in trouble. Not watching from outside. With Immanuel, God with us. Matthew 1:23, in the trouble, in the valley, in the fire, in the flood, with Shondai Tumbalare Ecclesia Kai Shondai Tumbalare Ecclesia Shondai Kai Tumbala Shondai Ecclesia The siege is over. I need you to hear what I am about to say and receive it as a word from the Lord. The attack that has been running against your life has just hit a wall. The wall is called Psalm 91. The wall is called the secret place. The wall is called the shadow of the Almighty. And that wall does not have cracks. Walk into your favor. It has been waiting. Walk into your week with the posture of the resident, not the visitor. Walk into your morning tomorrow with a declaration. The Lord is my refuge. The Lord is my fortress. He is my God. In him I trust. Your destiny is preserved by the blood. Your household is covered by the feathers of the almighty. Your children are surrounded by angelic assignment. Your finances are under the covering of the dwelling place. Your health is hidden in the secret place of the most high. I decree this week is not ordinary. This week you move as a resident of the secret place. This week the thousand falls at your side and it does not reach you. This week the arrow flies by day and it finds no target in your life. This week the pestilence walks in darkness and it walks past your door. From this altar, from this moment, you go as one who has moved into the secret place. You go as one who has set their love upon the most high. You go as one to whom God himself has said, "I will deliver you. I will set you on high. I will answer you. I will be with you. I will honor you. With long life will I satisfy you and show you my salvation. Shondai ecclesia. Rekai tumbala. Shondai tumbala ecclesia. Rekai shondai. It is done. The secret place is your address. The shadow is your covering. The angels have their orders and heaven has sealed this covenant. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Isaiah 54:17. Not one. Not today. Not ever. Amen and amen.
